name: Have I Been Pwned
purpose: Check whether an email address appears in known breaches indexed by the service.
limit: A negative result cannot rule out a breach. Search an address you are entitled to check.

name: Bitwarden
purpose: Store unique passwords and supported passkeys in a vault.
audience: Individuals and teams · Desktop, mobile and browser
limit: Plan account recovery and secure the vault before depending on it.

name: Microsoft Defender Antivirus
purpose: Use the malware protection built into supported Windows installations.
limit: Keep protection updates current. A clean scan alone does not close an investigation.

name: VirusTotal
purpose: Compare scanner findings for a public file or URL, or look up an existing report.
limit: Never upload confidential files, private URLs, tokens or customer data to public scanning services. Submissions can be shared.

name: Wireshark
purpose: Inspect authorised packet captures during network troubleshooting.
audience: IT support and network operators · Windows, macOS and Linux
limit: Captures may contain sensitive data. Limit collection to networks you are authorised to inspect.
